definitions.raw: candidate minus recorded valve prediction, degrees C
definitions.signed: sign(dose) times raw; desired-direction reference is signed < 0
definitions.desired_area: sum_t(max(-signed,0))*10, right endpoint degrees C seconds
definitions.reverse_area: sum_t(max(signed,0))*10, right endpoint degrees C seconds
definitions.distributions: Across saved valid origins; std is population descriptive std; not CI
definitions.plateau: Not assessed; terminal/last60s is not steady-state gain
